name: eu-ai-act
description: EU AI Act regulatory question with EU geography. Should route to GTTA reasoning + EU regional specialist only. No CA+Caspian, no Gulf+ME, no sanctions sector. ROADMAP's earlier 'global-only' phrasing was imprecise — the EU vertical is itself a regional specialist; what 'global-only' means here is 'no Central Asia or Gulf specialist needed'.

request.question: How will the EU AI Act enforcement timeline shift for general-purpose models given the regulatory simplification push over 18 months?
